entries.sanskrit: सह सदस्यै ऋत्विग्भिश् च वर्तमणम् । तेऽपि भगवद्-धर्म-श्रवण-परा बभूवुर् इत्य् अर्थः । भगवद्-धर्म-तद्-भक्त-माया-तत्-तरणानि च । ब्रह्म-कर्मावतारेहा-भक्त-प्राप्य-युग-क्रमान् ॥ ज्ञातुं क्रमेण कृतवान् नव प्रश्नान् निमिर् नव । एकैकस्योत्तरं प्रोचुः कवि-मुख्या मुनीश्वराः ॥३२॥
word_for_word: together with the members of the assembly
intent on listening to the Lord's dharma
and the ways of crossing it
the great sages led by Kavi
entries.literal_english: The king was together with the members of the assembly and the officiating priests; they also became intent upon hearing the Lord's dharma. Nimi put nine questions in order to learn of the Lord's dharma, the devotee, illusion and crossing it, Brahman, action, divine descent and divine activity, what devotees attain, and the sequence of the ages. The nine great sages led by Kavi answered them one by one.
entries.note: The Sanskrit witness reads वर्तमणम् and prints a compact list in metrical form. Punctuation in that list is editorial; the Sanskrit wording is not silently normalized.

entries.sanskrit: प्रथमम् आत्यन्तिकं क्षेमं [११.२.३०] कथयति---मन्य इति । न कुतश्चिद् भयं यस्मात् तद् अकुतश्चिद्-भयम् । अत्र संसारेऽसद्-आत्म-भावाद् असति देहादाव् आत्म-भावनातो नित्यं सर्वदोद्विग्न-बुद्धेर् विश्वात्मना सर्वथा निःशेषं यत्र पादाम्बुजोपासने भीर् निवर्तते, तत् ॥३३॥
word_for_word: that is freedom from fear on every side
because of identifying the non-self as oneself
in the unreal body and the like
of one whose mind is always distressed
in which worship of [the Lord's] lotus feet
entries.literal_english: First, he explains the ultimate welfare mentioned at 11.2.30, beginning ‘I think.’ The worship in which fear from every quarter is absent is ‘free from fear on every side.’ Here in saṃsāra, identifying the non-self, such as the body, as oneself makes one's mind continually troubled; in worship of the Lord's lotus feet that fear ceases altogether, without remainder.
entries.note: This reflects Śrīdhara's identification of asad-ātma-bhāva as taking the body and similar things to be the self, not a different reading inserted from later commentators.

entries.sanskrit: भागवत-धर्म-लक्षणम् आह---ये वै इति । मन्व्-आदि-मुखेन वर्णाश्रमादि-धर्मान् उक्त्वा अतिरहस्यत्वात् स्व-मुखेनैव भगवताअविदुषाम् अपि पुंसाम् अञ्जः सुखेनैव आत्म-लब्धये ये वै उपायाः प्रोक्ताः, तान् भागवतान् धर्मान् विद्धि ॥३४॥
word_for_word: dharmas such as varṇa and āśrama obligations
entries.literal_english: He defines bhāgavata-dharma with the verse beginning ‘those indeed.’ Having taught duties such as varṇa and āśrama through Manu and others, the Lord himself taught, through his own mouth, means by which even the unlearned may easily attain the self, because this teaching is exceedingly secret. Know those means to be the bhāgavata dharmas.
entries.note: The Sanskrit source joins भगवता and अविदुषाम् without a space; the joined reading is kept in the Sanskrit panel while word meanings segment the expression.

scope: Complete source-bound Śrīdhara commentary for Canto 11 Chapter 2, verses 11.2.32–11.2.34.
